mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during FEDFUNDS decline, or FEDFUNDS does not trend downward over a 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of the unemployment rate above 4.3% triggers investor concerns about labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.1 percentage points in the next month
failure_condition: UNRATE crosses above 4.3% but SPX 20d returns remain positive, or the rate increase is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous drop in demand (GDPC1) below 23,700 and surge in supply (INDPRO) above 104.0 indicates a recessionary gap, causing S&P 500 forward returns to decline over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < 23700 and INDPRO > 104.0 in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns not negative when both proxies meet criteria, or OLS correlation between proxies and returns < 0.5 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), elevated interest rates reduce corporate earnings growth expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains above 4.5% but SPX 20d returns are positive, or tightening does not precede contraction in GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent high unemployment (PAYEMS) above historical averages signals weak labor market growth, prompting investors to anticipate slower economic expansion and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS remains elevated but SPX 20d returns are positive, or no significant correlation over 5-year period.

mechanism_narrative: An abrupt surge in supply (INDPRO) exceeding 105.0 (5% above 2017 baseline) triggers inflation concerns, leading to S&P 500 forward returns falling over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises > 5 percentage points in 3 months
failure_condition: INDPRO crosses above 105.0 but SPX 20d returns are positive, or the supply increase is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in economic demand (GDPC1) above 23,700 signals robust growth, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 trends upward but SPX 60d returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05), or no correlation over 4-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5%) and weak demand (GDPC1 < 23,700) create a recessionary dual signal, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 4.5 and GDPC1 < 23700 in the same month
failure_condition: Both proxies meet criteria but SPX 20d returns are positive, or interaction effect (product) < 0.3 in OLS regression.
